description: This is a wide, multi-lane boulevard with smooth pavement and landscaped medians/roadside hedges that provide strong separation from traffic, but the roadway appears designed for relatively high vehicle speeds. A sidewalk or side path is visible along the right side and looks continuous and unobstructed, with streetlights and rows of trees adding greenery and some shade, though no clear curb ramps, crosswalks, or other pedestrian accessibility features are visible in this view.
